name: mirage
text: Found it: after every phone restart the app switched off Auto-bet and the Bids tab's Automatic, and because settings are mirrored to GitHub that also stopped the engine's bids. I've changed it so that while the GitHub engine is trading (Paper or Live) a restart leaves those two switches alone. Only background auto-scan on the phone is still reset. The change is in the code and under test now; it reaches your phone with the next release (I'll ship it with the next batch). Until then, after a phone restart, check the Bids tab is still on Automatic.
